note: Extracted orphan mechanisms. Not a note-only list.

records.definition: orphan.hook-pre-tool is a workflow mechanism: a named pre-tool hook stage that runs before every tool invocation and may abort the call. Discriminating example: a deny from this hook prevents the tool from running, unlike a post-tool tracer which can only observe.
discriminating_examples: a deny from this hook prevents the tool from running, unlike a post-tool tracer which can only observe
post-tool tracer cannot abort; this hook can

records.definition: orphan.not-worth.stub is a deprecated alias with no independent behaviour. It exists only so an older name still resolves; it must be preserved as an archive record so retirement does not silently delete the name, but it is not worth extracting into an active target blueprint for reuse.
discriminating_examples: alias with no extra stage behaviour vs a real hook or quorum

records.definition: orphan.reject-quorum is a workflow mechanism: a merge stage that cannot run until a named review quorum of independent reviewers has recorded PASS. Discriminating example: a single author self-ack does not satisfy the quorum; two distinct reviewer ids must vote, and the merge is refused while the vote set is short.
discriminating_examples: a single author self-ack does not satisfy the quorum; two distinct reviewer ids must vote, and the merge is refused while the vote set is short
author self-ack is not a quorum
